description: We are a creative team interested in space, science, and discovering new things. Our project will explore NASA's old equipment on the Moon and Mars. We want to explain how these machines worked, what they discovered, and why they are important. We enjoy learning, sharing ideas, and working together to make space science easy and interesting for everyone.
summary: NEXGALAXY – MISSION QUEST is an educational space mission design game that allows players to experience the process of planning a space mission. Players can choose a mission goal, design a spacecraft, select scientific instruments, manage a budget, and make important decisions to complete their mission successfully. Our project addresses the NASA Space Mission Design Game challenge by making space exploration easier to understand through an interactive and creative experience. It teaches players about satellites, Earth observation, spacecraft technology, and teamwork. This project is important because it encourages students to explore science, technology, engineering, and space research while developing problem-solving and decision-making skills. Our goal is to make learning about space exciting, educational, and accessible to everyone.
details: NEXGALAXY – MISSION QUEST is an educational space mission design game that allows students to experience how real space missions are planned. Players choose a mission objective, design a spacecraft, select scientific instruments, manage a budget, and make decisions to complete their mission successfully. The project benefits students by teaching them about space exploration, satellite technology, Earth observation, and spacecraft systems in a simple and enjoyable way. Its intended impact is to inspire young people to learn more about science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM), while improving their creativity, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. We used PowerPoint to develop and present our project, along with Canva for presentation design and ChatGPT for assistance with organizing ideas and explanations. We also used NASA educational resources to learn about space missions and satellite technology. The creative part of our project is turning the complicated process of planning a space mission into an exciting game where players make their own choices. Our team considered mission goals, spacecraft design, scientific equipment, available budgets, and possible challenges. We wanted to create a project that is educational, creative, easy to understand, and interesting for students.
